text:
Maya (Finance): FYI — AcmeCloud just sent an updated price sheet for our marketplace listing. They want a ~12% uplift on embedding credits starting 2025-05-01. They also changed the unit ID in invoices, which will break our recon if we don't map it. Need to coordinate rollout, grandfathering for some legacy customers, and a short A/B to measure churn/ARPU impact. Attaching sheet and sample invoice.

Tom (Revenue Ops): Can we scope the A/B to new signups only? Prefer feature-flagged split (50/50) for 2 weeks. Also need to ensure metering preserves the unit_code so we don't double-bill.

Anil (Billing Eng): Noted — vendor uses `emb_credit_unit` instead of our `emb_credits`. I can add an alias in the ingestion pipeline and a quick transform in billing-preproc. Will open PR to billing-mapping repo. Example override we can push:```json
{"emb_credit_unit":"emb_credits"}```
Will also add a runnable rollback if invoices start failing.

billing-bot: Invoice ingest alert — AcmeCloud invoice 2025-04-18 failed schema validation (missing unit_code). Link: https://billing.example.com/ingest/alerts/1756012367 :warning:

Maya (Finance): Thanks Anil. Two related asks: (1) Finance needs to agree revenue recognition for the uplift on prepaid bundles (is this acceleration?), (2) product/marketing needs messaging for affected customers (legacy vs new). For grandfathering, proposal: preserve current effective per-unit price for active paid subs through 2025-07-01, then migrate on a rolling basis.

Priya (Legal): Send the vendor amendment draft. If we're preserving rates for legacy paid subs we need a clause for exceptions and a notice period; also confirm whether vendor requires signature for the updated rate or if a written confirmation email suffices. I can review by EOD Friday if I get the draft today.

Dana (Product): Will need the final price table and the list of customer cohorts that are eligible for grandfathering. Also want to ensure the UI shows the change only at invoice/usage details, not on the core pricing page for current subs.

Tom (Revenue Ops): I'll own the flag rollout with eng — flag name `acme_new_pricing`. Will coordinate a canary (5% traffic), then 50/50 for 2 weeks, then 100% if metrics look good. Metrics: $/embedding, retention at 7/14/30d, and invoice failure rate.

Anil (Billing Eng): PR tracker: #482-add-acme-alias. I'll include integration test against an Acme sample invoice and add a monitoring alert if mapping rate drops below 99.5%. ETA for PR: tomorrow morning.

Maya (Finance): Action items recap: 
- Anil: PR for ingestion mapping + rollback runbook (ETA tomorrow)
- Tom: feature flag + canary plan + gating metrics (setup by Mon)
- Priya: contract/notice language review (by Fri)
- Dana: UI copy + cohort list (by Mon)
- Finance: final revenue recognition calc and sign-off (by Thu)

Maya (Finance): I'll schedule a vendor sync Wed 10am PT and invite legal + eng + product. If anyone can't make it, please DM me. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

Tom (Revenue Ops): Also — vendor asked if we can delay rollout for enterprise accounts with active negotiations. Recommend opt-out list via `acme_exempt_customers` tag.

Priya (Legal): Good call. Include opt-out mechanics in the amendment draft.

Maya (Finance): Perfect. I'll update the pricing experiment doc and share the link once the cohort definitions are locked. Thanks everyone.
